title: 第1351章 科索夜的信第1350章 枪
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
（感谢.拉盖.的打赏加更35）
几个月后，科索已死的消息传遍整个兽人世界，引起了轩然大波。
兽人世界的最高领导人之死，极大的打击了兽人的信心。
一些原本还在组织的兽人部队自动解散，还有一些人则是更加愤怒，开始寻找组织，想要复国。
此时兽人世界的最东方，熊兽人们收到科索普死亡的消息后，心情十分复杂。
尤其是那些主动背叛科索的兽人们，一种愧疚情绪充斥在他们心头，让他们不知道该如何面对世人。
此时兽人世界的东北方向，某个几乎和矮人世界接壤的海港城市，科索夜正在躲在一个房间里痛哭。
就在刚刚，他收到了鹰兽人传递的信息，他的父亲被联盟大军炸死在了鹰眼山上，这对他来说是十分巨大的打击，他失去了他的父亲！
从今以后，他父亲扛的那些东西，落在了他的肩膀上，他要负责带着日月神国的残部，寻找新的道路。
哭了好一会儿后，他擦掉眼泪，开始伏案写信。
他写了两封信，一封是给矮人之王的，一封是给大首领的。
其中给矮人之王的信如此写道：
日月神国王子，神王科索之子，向矮人之王致敬。
相信矮人之王已经收到消息，家父已战死，日月神国即将倾覆。
在这危急之时，我时常想起父亲的话，他对矮人之王，以及矮人世界对我兽人一族的支援多有感激。
我兽人一族工业贫乏，缺少武器枪炮，正是慷慨矮人王的赠予，才让我兽人大军拥有现代化枪械火炮，能与联盟之凶残入侵者抗争。
在局势最艰难的时刻，矮人王更是派出奇迹武器，及其部曲前来支援，我兽人一族对矮人感激不尽。
奈何敌人凶残，我兽人一族死战，却仍是丢失故土，父亲更是战死沙场。
如今大势所逼，我只能携带少量部曲，蜗居兽人世界东北海港。
经过此次大败，日月神国名存实亡，联盟大军却还在磨刀霍霍，准备跨越鹰神山脉，向我残部杀来，将其赶尽杀绝！

如今我心力尽散，已不想权谋复国，只想带领身边残部，让他们活下去。
在此，日月神国王子科索夜，恳求矮人之王，能支援货船，让在下带领残部，跨过大洋，去往新世界，寻找新的出路。
写完这封信后，科索夜将其封好，开始写第二封给大首领的信：
尊敬的大首领，您的部队是如此的雄壮，枪炮是如此的犀利，兽人世界已被你征服，您将获得一切。
如今乾坤在手，在下万分恭贺。
只是在下听闻，大首领的兵峰近日正在厉兵秣马，跨过鹰神山脉，东征兽人世界以东。
content_en:
(Thanks to Lagai. for the reward and an update of 35)
Months later, news of Corso's death spread throughout the orc world, causing an uproar.
The death of the top leader of the orc world has greatly damaged the confidence of the orcs.
Some of the orc troops that were still organized automatically disbanded, while others became even more angry and began to look for organizations to restore their country.
At this time, in the easternmost part of the orc world, the bear orcs had very complicated emotions after receiving the news of Kosopp's death.
Especially those orcs who took the initiative to betray Corso, a feeling of guilt filled their hearts, making them not know how to face the world.
At this time, in the northeast of the orc world, in a seaport city almost bordering the dwarf world, Koso Ye was hiding in a room and crying bitterly.
Just now, he received a message from the Eagle Beastmen. His father was killed on Eagle Eye Mountain by the Alliance army. This was a huge blow to him. He lost his father!
From now on, the things his father carried fell on his shoulders, and he was responsible for leading the remnants of the Sun and Moon Kingdom to find a new path.
After crying for a while, he wiped away his tears and began to write a letter at his desk.
He wrote two letters, one to the Dwarf King and one to the Great Chief.
One of the letters to the King of the Dwarves reads:
The prince of the Sun and Moon Kingdom, son of the god-king Corso, pays homage to the King of the Dwarves.
I believe that the King of the Dwarves has received the news that my father has been killed in the battle and that the Kingdom of the Sun and Moon is about to fall.
In this critical moment, I often think of my father's words. He is very grateful to the King of Dwarves and the dwarf world for their support to my orc family.
Our orc clan is poor in industry and lacks weapons and artillery. It is the gift from the generous dwarf king that allows our orc army to have modern firearms and artillery to fight against the ferocious invaders of the Alliance.
At the most difficult moment of the situation, the Dwarf King even sent Miracle Weapons and his tribe to support. We, the orcs, are deeply grateful to the dwarves.
However, the enemy was ferocious, and my orc clan fought to the death, but still lost our homeland, and my father even died in the battle.
Nowadays, the situation is forcing me to carry only a few pieces with me and live in the northeastern seaport of the orc world.
After this great defeat, the Kingdom of the Sun and Moon God exists in name only, but the Alliance army is still sharpening its swords, preparing to cross the Eagle God Mountain Range, attack my remaining troops, and drive them all to death!
Now that I am exhausted, I no longer want to seek power to restore the country. I just want to lead the remaining troops around me and let them survive.
Here, Kosoye, the prince of the Sun and Moon God King, begged the king of the dwarves to support the cargo ship and let me lead the remaining troops across the ocean to the new world and find a new way out.
After writing this letter, Kosoye sealed it and began to write the second letter to the big leader:
Dear leader, your troops are so majestic and your guns are so sharp. The orc world has been conquered by you, and you will gain everything.
Now that I have the world in my hand, I congratulate you greatly.
I just heard that the great leader's troops are currently preparing their troops across the Eagle God Mountain Range to conquer the east of the orc world.
